titles.english: If I Could Become a Comet

description:
Music video directed and animated by Harumaki Gohan for the song If I Could Become a Comet by Harumaki Gohan.

Note: There exists two versions of this song; the first being a self-cover version by Harumaki Gohan on YouTube, and a vocaloid version featuring Hatsune Miku on NicoNico.
